adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration immediately does `execute(...)[0]['id'].to_i` on the result of a SELECT that can legitimately return 0 rows when `site_settings.name = 'embed_category'` is unset/blank or doesn’t match any `categories.name`. With an empty result, indexing `[0]` (or then `['id']`) will raise before the `if category_id == 0` fallback is reached, so the migration can fail on typical installs where embed_category isn’t configured.
